name: Extreme Feedback Stability (98%)
description: Validates stability at maximum feedback (98%) - the effect should remain stable without runaway, explosion, or NaN. Tests edge case feedback behavior.

capability_requirements.notes: Tests maximum feedback stability (98% is the limit)

late_stage.description: Late stage - should still be stable

no_runaway.description: Even at 98% feedback, must not grow energy

sustained_signal.description: Signal should sustain with extreme feedback

no_clipping.description: Must not clip even with extreme feedback

slow_decay.description: Decay should be very slow but stable

rt60_feedback_decay.description: RT60 at 98% feedback measured ~0.35s (delay-line decay, not room reverb); tightened from initial 60.0s max after evaluation

feedback_edt.description: Early decay time at extreme feedback. May report 0.0 if decay range is insufficient for Schroeder analysis (delay-line decay vs room reverb).

feedback_crest.description: Crest factor at 98% feedback. Impulse response produces high crest (~49 dB measured). Wide tolerance for edge-case dynamics.

pass_criteria: Stable sustained signal without runaway or clipping
